points.guidance: Official M1: method criterion must be explicitly satisfied; the associated later A award depends on this method award.
Official A1: answer/accuracy award. The associated preceding M criterion must have been awarded.

points.text: Maximum energy of emitted electrons is independent of intensity, OR no emission of electrons below threshold frequency regardless of intensity, OR no emission of electrons when photon energy is less than work function regardless of intensity.
In darkness: conduction band empty so high resistance.
In daylight: electrons in valence band absorb photons.
In daylight: electrons jump to conduction band.
This leaves holes in valence band.
More charge carriers in daylight so resistance decreases.
